profileArchiveTests.note: Full 29-suite runs passed before final subtitle-reference rebasing; the entire 20-case profile suite and package smoke were rerun after that isolated change

features: View > Profile and backups dialog and command
export settings and selected assets to versioned .foxicmp-profile JSON
manual unique backups in the profile Backups directory without including previous backups
import into a new profile directory, never overwrite the running profile
open imported profile in a separate --new-instance --profile player
preserve Qt INI value types, playlist tabs, history, positions and favorites
materialize selected artwork, translation and manual ICC under Assets content hashes
include Subtitles/Edits; omit media, screenshots, extracted subtitles, generated shader caches and programs
rebase managed subtitle references in playlist metadata to the restored directory, including repeated export/import
omit machine-local MIME integration and undo journal; imported startup registration disabled
strict relative path allowlist, SHA-256 per file, strict base64 and version/INI validation
atomic QSaveFile archive writes and sibling staging + renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE directory publication
request owner-only permissions for archive and restored files; effective permissions depend on filesystem
verified: typed settings and library round trip with Unicode paths
all four selected asset settings remapped to copied resources
managed subtitle metadata rebased through two consecutive transfers; external paths and other metadata strings unchanged
malformed paths, hashes, base64, versions, duplicate and conflicting entries rejected
existing files/directories, symlinks and dangling links not overwritten
named pipe rejected without waiting; size/count limits enforced
escaped filename metadata exceeding the final JSON cap stops export below the raw data cap
failed staged file write leaves no destination or temporary profile
UI export, cancel import and successful import using actual Qt dialogs
manual backup while paused keeps source/position and captures current playlist
stripped package playback/CLI/MPRIS/helpers and prior settings preservation
translations: English catalog: 1415 source strings covered; 1443 entries; placeholders valid
limitations: Import creates a new directory; replacing a running profile and changing the default launcher are not implemented
External media paths are retained; relative paths need the same media layout beside the imported profile
Selected missing resources stop export with a file path error
Archives contain history, favorites and saved URLs; SHA-256 is not authentication or encryption
Manual backups have no automatic schedule or retention
Profile I/O is synchronous and bounded by the documented limits
VirtualBox shared folder ignores Unix permission mode: 0600 request results in 0777; owner-only checks pass on native /tmp filesystem
Directory publication uses Linux renameat2; physical GPU/Wayland remain unverified
remainingItem17: profile reset and persistent location/default-launcher UI
title customization, updates, process priority and crash reporting
web control and remaining Classic CLI
appropriate folder/disc integration; user-deferred physical devices/disc menus/analog TV remain deferred
